┌─────────────────────────────────│bint 0.1.0│─────────────────────────────────┐
│ Overview │ Kn │ Tk │ Rn │ Ev │ Evo │ Sy                                      │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── /work/demo ─┘
┌─│Setup│──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                                              │
│   This repository is not set up for Bint yet                                 │
│                                                                              │
│   Bint is not initialized in /work/demo. Setup only creates local            │
│   configuration and state; running it again is always safe.                  │
│                                                                              │
│   • Creates .bint/config.yml (never overwrites an existing configuration).   │
│   • Creates a local state directory outside the repository, with its         │
│     SQLite database.                                                         │
│   • Does not install hooks in the non-interactive setup; add them later      │
│     with `bint init --hooks`.                                                │
│   • Adds the bint block to .gitignore.                                       │
│                                                                              │
│   The core harness skills are published as well. No model is called and no   │
│   project command is run.                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│   Equivalent CLI command: bint init                                          │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
└─[Enter→ Initialize] [r→ Re-check] [:→ Commands] [q→ Quit] [?→ Help]──────────┘
